title: Government insists its new jet can land in bad weather
description: The Coalition has insisted there are no issues with a new Government jet after reports it may struggle to land in bad weather.
content:
The Coalition has insisted there are no issues with a new Government jet after reports it may struggle to land in bad weather.

de: Die Regierung besteht darauf, dass ihr neuer Jet auch bei schlechtem Wetter landen kann. Die Koalition hat darauf bestanden, dass es keine Probleme mit einem neuen Regierungsflugzeug gebe, nachdem Berichten zufolge bei schlechtem Wetter Probleme mit der Landung auftreten könnten.
en: Government insists its new jet can land in bad weather. The Coalition has insisted there are no issues with a new Government jet after reports it may struggle to land in bad weather.
la: Regimen suum instat nova vi tempestatis in terram deponere potest. Coalitio affirmavit nullas esse quaestiones cum novo Regimine vimineae postquam nuntiationes adversae tempestatibus ad terram luctari possunt.
